title: Investigating low-frequency electronic noise in quasi-1D charge-density-wave nanowires
core_idea: Determine whether the collective sliding electron–lattice condensate in quasi-1D, fully gapped CDW nanowires leads to fundamentally different low-frequency electronic noise behavior compared with normal electron transport, by measuring current noise spectral densities versus current and bias and examining the role of pinning, threshold fields, and device geometry.
tldr: Probe whether collective sliding charge-density-wave transport in quasi-1D nanowires alters low-frequency (1/f) electronic noise and assess implications for noise limits in nanoscale and quantum electronic devices.
